response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Timekeeper' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching him. As she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel must use her skills to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. With the Timekeeper's next victim just hours away, Rachel must work against the clock to unravel the mystery and prevent a catastrophic future. But as she delves deeper into the case, she realizes that the Timekeeper's true intentions are far more sinister than she ever imagined.
